attributes.action: Require a General Election Whenever a Prime Minister Resigns or Is Replaced
attributes.additional_details: At present, a new Prime Minister can take office without a general election if they are chosen by the governing party. We believe this weakens democratic accountability. The law should require an immediate general election whenever a Prime Minister resigns, is removed, or is replaced, so the public—not only political parties—decides who governs the United Kingdom through a fresh democratic mandate.
attributes.background: Require a general election whenever a Prime Minister resigns, is removed, or is replaced during a Parliament, so the incoming Prime Minister must obtain a fresh democratic mandate from the electorate before taking office.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: 

The removal or death of a PM should trigger a general election
